title: Yi Jia Liow
text:
I am a postdoctoral scholar in the Department of Gastroenterology at Duke University. My research focuses on gut sensing of dietary substrates and how that information is relayed to the brain.
I received my PhD from the University of Tokyo in 2026, where I examined how diet shapes host eating behavior via the microbiome-gut-brain axis.
Outside of academia, I make ceramics.
You can reach me at yijia.liow@gmail.com.
